subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should this issue ship warning-only Control UI MEMORY.md budget visibility first, or also enforce oversized-save blocking and auto-archive behavior now?
rationale: Current main already has partial diagnostics, but refusing saves or moving memory content changes user editing, recovery, and gateway API semantics beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Ship warning-only first
options.body: Add the Control UI budget indicator and near-limit warning using configured bootstrap limits while leaving blocking and archive behavior for separate decisions.

options.title: Enforce oversized saves
options.body: Make the UI and/or `agents.files.set` refuse MEMORY.md saves over the configured budget with a visible override or recovery path.

options.title: Design archive separately
options.body: Treat auto-archive as a memory persistence feature with pointers, undo, and recovery semantics before implementation.

recommendation.title: Ship warning-only first
recommendation.body: Add the Control UI budget indicator and near-limit warning using configured bootstrap limits while leaving blocking and archive behavior for separate decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice likely crosses Gateway RPC, Control UI editing, and product recovery policy, and history shows steipete as a strong recent owner signal for the relevant gateway file surface.
